name: CBT-i Coach
one_liner: CBT-i Coach is the gold-standard free app for insomnia, developed by the VA using Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-i), the first-line treatment recommended by sleep medicine specialists.
best_for: Adults with chronic insomnia wanting evidence-based treatment
Those working with a therapist on CBT-i who need between-session support
Veterans and civilians seeking free, research-backed sleep tools
People who prefer structured sleep programs over medication
Those wanting to understand and track their sleep patterns
not_for: People with untreated sleep apnea or other sleep disorders requiring medical evaluation
Those seeking quick fixes without commitment to behavior change
short_description: Free CBT-i app from the VA offering sleep diaries, relaxation exercises, and evidence-based insomnia treatment tools.
long_description: CBT-i Coach is a free mobile app developed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs to help people with insomnia. It uses Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-i), which is the first-line treatment recommended by medical guidelines. The app includes sleep diaries, relaxation audio, educational content about sleep, and tools to implement CBT-i techniques like stimulus control and sleep restriction. It's designed to be used alongside therapy or as a self-help tool.
patient_summary: CBT-i Coach is a free app that helps you sleep better using the same techniques therapists use for insomnia. You'll learn why you're not sleeping, track your sleep patterns, and use proven strategies to fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer.

pricing.notes: Completely free with no in-app purchases or subscriptions.

privacy.notes: Developed by the VA. Data stored locally on device. No account required.

faqs.a: Yes, CBT-i Coach is completely free with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or hidden costs. It was developed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs as a public health resource.

faqs.q: Can I use CBT-i Coach without a therapist?
faqs.a: Yes. While CBT-i Coach was designed to supplement therapy, many people use it as a standalone self-help tool. The app includes educational content and guided exercises that can be used independently.

faqs.q: How long does it take for CBT-i Coach to work?
faqs.a: Most people see improvements within 2-4 weeks of consistent use. CBT-i typically takes 4-8 weeks for full effect. The key is following the program consistently, including keeping sleep diaries and implementing the behavioral strategies.

faqs.q: Is CBT-i Coach only for veterans?
faqs.a: No. While developed by the VA, CBT-i Coach is available to anyone. The app is free for all civilians and veterans alike.
